results.title: King in the Land of the Princess
results.original_title: King in the Land of the Princess
results.overview: A King, a princess. Their encounter in a makeshift Opera tent in a village. Here in today's rural Bangladesh, the film brings up a colourful but understated drama of human and artistic dilemmas. While the princess is sought after on stage, on TikTok and in flesh by all the men – audiences watching the stage, the businessmen, the local politicians; behind the stage, the king waits and waits for his turn. He has to complete a story he began, long back.

results.title: The Hunt Down 2
results.overview: In 2004, on the vast Gobi wasteland of northwest China, the violent gang led by Xu Sihai robs a mine escort vehicle, committing a series of bloody crimes before fleeing for their lives. During the escape, the gang falls apart, turning against each other over stolen loot. Criminal police captain Yang Zhigang traverses the desert to hunt them down based on trace clues, leading to a slew of hardcore gunfights and car chases. Moral gray areas complicate this showdown between good and evil.

results.title: Itam: A Sun Bear Story
results.overview: Three years in the making, this remarkable documentary was filmed entirely in Sabah, Malaysia. It follows the rehabilitation and release of a rescued sun bear named Itam. Developed in close collaboration with the Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre, the production was granted rare access to archival records, veterinary logs, field operations, and the complete rewilding process. This access allows the film to move beyond surface observation into deeply-researched, character-driven storytelling. Combining immersive cinematic language with investigative scientific inquiry, ITAM: A SUN BEAR STORY positions Southeast Asian conservation stories within global discourse.
